description: This file declares the class DobbySpecGenerator, which is responsible for generating runtime specifications in JSON format for containerized applications, including creating environment variables, mounts, plugins, and other configuration details. It includes external dependencies such as jsoncpp, application configuration, and runtime management interfaces.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating container runtime specifications in JSON format based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing the runtime specification based on provided application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variables JSON object based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates mount points JSON object based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates RDK plugin configurations in JSON format.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates an App Service SDK plugin configuration.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a bind mount JSON object with source, destination, and options.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines if GPU should be enabled based on application configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves system memory limit based on configurations.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves GPU memory limit based on configurations.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU is enabled based on configurations.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates classic plugin configurations into the JSON specification.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates FKPS mounts in the specification.
